# VistaView v2 Documentation - Index

> Generated: 2026-06-26T11:51:13.482Z

## About VistaView

VistaView is a lightweight, modern image lightbox library for the web. Zero dependencies, and highly customizable.

## Documentation Sections

For AI consumption, the documentation is split into manageable sections:

- **[llms-core.txt](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/llms-core.txt)** - Core installation and configuration (15 docs)
- **[llms-integrations.txt](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/llms-integrations.txt)** - Framework integrations: React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Vanilla JS (5 docs)
- **[llms-extensions.txt](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/llms-extensions.txt)** - Extensions for videos, maps, and more (17 docs)
- **[llms-styling.txt](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/llms-styling.txt)** - CSS theming and customization (3 docs)
- **[llms-api.txt](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/llms-api.txt)** - Complete API reference and types (12 docs)
- **[AI Integration](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/ai-integration)** - MCP Server, Markdown for Agents, LLMs.txt setup

## AI Integration

VistaView provides agent-ready documentation:

- **MCP Server**: JSON-RPC endpoint at `POST /mcp` with tools: `get_package_info`, `get_build_status`, `search_docs`
- **Markdown for Agents**: Set `Accept: text/markdown` on any doc URL for clean Markdown
- **LLMs.txt**: This index plus categorized full-text files below
- **Setup guides**: [AI Integration page](https://vistaview.jujiplay.com/ai-integration) includes Claude Desktop config

## Quick Stats

- Total documentation pages: 54

## Installation

```bash
npm install vistaview
```

## Quick Start

```javascript
import { vistaView } from 'vistaview';
import 'vistaview/style.css';

vistaView({
  elements: '#gallery > a',
});
```
